description: This file defines the Session class within the Admin Controller Startup namespace of the OpenCart project. It manages session initialization, session ID handling via cookies, session configuration, and security settings for the admin interface.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Handles session management for the admin startup process, including session initiation, cookie handling, and configuration updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the session, retrieves or creates a session ID, updates session lifetime, and sets security options for cookies.
